PPTC stands for Polymetric Positive Temperature Coefficient. Description: The ACT8846 is a complete, cost effective, and highly-efficient Active PMUTM power management solution optimized for the power, voltage sequencing and control requirements of Rockchip RK31x8 application processor family. The ACT8846 features four fixed-frequency, current mode, synchronous PWM step-down converters that achieve peak efficiencies of up to 97%. These regulators operate with a fixed frequency of 2.25MHz, minimizing noise in sensitive applications and allowing the use of small external components. These buck regulators supply up to 2.8A of output current and can fully satisfy the power and control requirements of the multi-core application processor. Dynamic Voltage Scaling (DVS) is supported either by dedicated control pins, or through I2C interface to optimize the energy per-task performance for the processor. This device also include eight low-noise LDOs (up to 350mA per LDO), one always-on LDO and an integrated backup battery charger to provide a complete power system for the processor. The power sequence and reset controller provides power-on reset, SW-initiated reset, and power cycle reset for the processor. It also features the watchdog supervisory function. Multiple sleep modes with autonomous sleep and wake-up sequence control are supported. The thermal management and protection subsystem allows the host processor to manage the power dissipation of the PMU and the overall system dynamically. The PMU provides a thermal warning to the host processor when the temperature reaches a certain threshold such that the system can turn off some of the non-essential functions, reduce the clock frequency and etc to manage the system temperature. The ACT8846 is available in a compact, TQFN66-48 package.

The ATMEGA328P- U is a low-power CMOS 8-bit microcontroller based on the AVR enhanced RISC architecture. The AVR core combines a rich instruction set with 32 general purpose working registers. All the 32 registers are directly connected to the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), allowing two independent registers to be accessed in one single instruction executed in one clock cycle. The resulting architecture is more code efficient while achieving throughputs up to ten times faster than conventional CISC microcontrollers.

The ATmega328P-PU AVR is supported with a full suite of program and system development tools including C Compilers, Macro Assemblers, Program Debugger/Simulators, In-Circuit Emulators, and Evaluation Kits.

Vin – this is the power pin. Since the sensor uses 3.3V, we have included an onboard voltage regulator that will take 3-5VDC and safely convert it down. To power, the board, give it the same power as the logic level of your microcontroller – e.g. for a 5V micro like Arduino, use 5V
3Vo – this is the 3.3V output from the voltage regulator, you can grab up to 100mA from this if you like
GND – common ground for power and logic
SCL – this is the I2C clock pin, connect to your microcontrollers I2C clock line. There is a 10K pull-up on this pin and it is level shifted so you can use 3 – 5VDC.
SDA – this is the I2C data pin, connect to your microcontrollers I2C data line. There is a 10K pull-up on this pin and it is level shifted so you can use 3 – 5VDC.
INT – this is the interrupt-output pin. It is 3V logic and you can use it to detect when something moves or changes in the sensor vision path.

blocks.text: Meet the DHT11 Temperature Humidity Sensor — the classic, compact, 4‑pin digital component (sensor only, not a module) that measures ambient relative humidity and temperature with a simple single‑wire interface. It operates on 3.5–5.5 V, features a stable indoor performance profile, and fits directly into breadboards thanks to its 2.54 mm pin spacing. Whether you are building a quick prototype, a classroom demo, or a budget‑friendly IoT node, this sensor keeps wiring simple and results repeatable.
✅ Breadboard‑ready pins: Standard 2.54 mm pitch and fixed orientation make wiring straightforward in tight spaces and quick labs.
🔌 Flexible supply: Works reliably from 3.5–5.5 V with very low average current, suitable for battery‑friendly data loggers.
⚙️ Single‑wire digital output: Transmits a 40‑bit frame (humidity, temperature, checksum) — no analog calibration or ADC channels required.
🌡️ Indoor‑range sensing: Temperature 0–50 °C and humidity 20–90 %RH for common room and enclosure monitoring.
🧪 Beginner‑friendly accuracy: ±2 °C temperature and ±5 %RH humidity are perfect for learning, dashboards, and non‑critical control.
🧱 Vented protective head: The blue slotted cap shields the sensing elements while allowing smooth airflow for responsive readings.
🧰 Strong ecosystem support: Works out of the box with popular microcontroller libraries and examples.
💡 Low‑power behavior: Sub‑milliamp average draw with brief peaks during conversions keeps your power budget lean.
✅ Simplicity first — one data pin, a pull‑up resistor, and you’re reading live climate values.
✅ Cost‑effective — trusted entry point for room‑level monitoring and education kits.
✅ Community‑proven — recipes and sketches are widely available for mainstream boards.
Pin 2 — DATA: Single‑wire bidirectional line. Add a 4.7–10 kΩ pull‑up to VDD near the host MCU for clean edges.
Pin 3 — NC: Not connected — leave floating.
Pin 4 — GND: Common ground with the controller.
✅ Keep the DATA wire short; long unshielded runs can degrade timing margins.
✅ If your MCU is 3.3 V and the sensor is powered at 5 V, use a level shifter or power the sensor at 3.3 V for logic safety.
✅ Place the pull‑up resistor physically close to the MCU pin to reduce ringing.
The host begins with a start pulse, after which the sensor acknowledges and shifts out 40 bits MSB‑first in this order:
8‑bit checksum (low 8 bits of the sum of the previous four bytes)
Each bit uses a fixed low time followed by a high period whose duration encodes 0 or 1. A practical sampling period is ≥ 2 seconds; reading faster can repeat older values or increase checksum errors.
Sampling period: ≥ 2 s (1 sample every 2–3 seconds is common in robust designs).
Response time: ~6–10 s for humidity steps under normal airflow.
Current: ~0.3 mA average during conversion; very low standby current.

Tip: If you need negative temperatures, sub‑zero operation, or tighter accuracy, step up to alternatives like higher‑grade digital humidity sensors. For educational builds and room monitoring, DHT11 Temperature Humidity Sensor remains an excellent fit.
✅ Arduino: Connect DATA to a digital GPIO (e.g., D2), add a 4.7–10 kΩ pull‑up to VCC, and include a well‑known DHT library. Poll no faster than every 2 seconds.
✅ ESP8266 / ESP32: Power at 3.3 V; use any available digital pin; keep wires short and stable. If Wi‑Fi tasks are heavy, avoid reading during RF bursts to reduce jitter.
✅ Raspberry Pi: Use a driver that honors microsecond timing. Ensure 3.3 V‑safe pull‑up on DATA and adequate delays between reads.
🔧 Checksum errors → Slow the polling rate, verify the pull‑up value, and shorten the cable.
🔧 Stale or fixed readings → Ensure proper start pulse width and the recommended delay between reads.
🔧 No response → Check ground reference, verify that DATA is not accidentally shorted to VDD, and confirm pin numbering.

ekostra-31334.summary: The MG90S is a compact 360° continuous rotation micro servo with full metal gears, ideal for driving wheels in small robots and automation projects.

blocks.text: MG90S Micro Servo Continuous Rotation 360 Degree (Full Metal Gear )

The MG90S Micro Servo Continuous Rotation 360° (Full Metal Gear) is a compact and powerful servo motor designed for small-scale robotics and automation projects requiring continuous motion. Unlike standard servo motors that rotate only 180°, this version is modified to rotate freely in both directions, making it ideal for applications such as robotic wheels, camera sliders, conveyor systems, and pan-tilt mechanisms.

Built with high-quality metal gears, the MG90S offers durability and wear resistance, ensuring a longer operational life compared to servos with plastic gears. Its full metal gear construction also allows it to handle more torque and stress without stripping or failing under moderate loads. Despite its small size, it provides sufficient torque for driving lightweight robotic platforms and other moving parts.

The MG90S operates on a standard 4.8V to 6V power supply and is compatible with popular microcontrollers like Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and others through simple PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) signals. The direction and speed of rotation are controlled by varying the pulse width — typically, 1.5 ms stops the motor, pulses less than 1.5 ms rotate it in one direction, and pulses above 1.5 ms rotate it in the opposite direction.

This servo comes with a standard 3-pin connector (Signal, VCC, GND) and is easy to integrate into a variety of electronics projects. Its compact form factor makes it especially suitable for space-constrained builds like mini-robots, remote-controlled toys, or animatronics.

Overall, the MG90S 360° continuous rotation servo combines durability, versatility, and ease of use, making it an excellent choice for hobbyists, students, and developers looking to add controlled motion to their creations in a small package.
Full 360° Motion: Unlike standard servos, this one rotates continuously — perfect for driving wheels or conveyor belts.
Bidirectional Speed Control: You can control both the direction and speed using simple PWM signals.
Compact Design: Its small size fits easily into tight spaces in mini robots, RC vehicles, and hobby projects.
Durable Metal Gears: With full metal gearing, it handles stress better than plastic servos and lasts longer.
Ideal for Mobility: Great for adding rotation to small robots, sliders, or camera systems.

DIY-Friendly: Beginner-friendly and supported by countless tutorials and project examples.
Great Value for Cost: Offers high performance in a low-cost, accessible package.
Included Accessories: Usually comes with servo horns and screws for quick integration into your builds.

These high-speed TTL circuits perform positive-logic multiplication of two 4-bit binary words to produce an 8-bit product. Designed for high-performance, parallel multiplication uses, the device generates the eight-bit binary product with a typical delay of about 40 ns, making it suitable as a fast arithmetic building block in digital systems.

The basic 4×4 multiplier is intended to be used as a fundamental building block for larger multipliers: multiple 4×4 devices can be combined to form 8×8, 16×16 (via partial-product summation such as Wallace trees), and other N×M multipliers. The datasheet illustrates how chaining these elements and using carry-save adders produces wider products with minimal added delay.

Characterized for standard TTL environments, the part is fully compatible with TTL logic families and includes diode-clamped inputs to simplify system design. Pinouts and timing diagrams are provided so designers can integrate the device into arithmetic units, multiply-accumulate structures, or custom ALU arrangements.

Upload the sketch: File > Upload to I/O Board
Wait for the “Done uploading” message in the bottom blue status bar
The LED labeled L near pin 13 should now blink slowly

An audio amplifier is an electronic circuit designed to amplify weak AC or DC signals to a higher amplitude range. Amplifiers are commonly found in devices such as mono speakers, stereo speakers, and audio amplifiers. Below is an audio amplifier circuit using a 2SC5200 transistor. This audio amplifier circuit can be built with various electronic components, including a 2SC5200 NPN power transistor, a 0.5 Watt 8 Ohms loudspeaker, a 3.5mm DC male or female jack, a 10K potentiometer, a 1K resistor, a 220uF electrolytic capacitor, a 12V DC power supply, battery clips, jumper wires, and a breadboard.

A 10K potentiometer controls the input voltage level, and a 220uF capacitor blocks the input signal’s DC component, allowing only the AC component. This AC signal acts as a control signal for the base terminal of the transistor.

The amplified output from the collector terminal of the 2SC5200 transistor moves to the negative terminal of a speaker, while the positive terminal connects to a DC power supply via a DC male power jack. To protect the transistor from overheating, a heat sink can be optionally used.

blocks.text: The UNI‑T UT262A is a compact, clamp‑type non‑contact phase detector engineered for rapid, safe verification of three‑phase AC systems without direct contact with live conductors. Its slim, ergonomic jaws (1.6 – 16 mm opening) allow effortless attachment around wires of various gauges, enabling electricians to identify phase rotation and presence of voltage in cramped panels or cable bundles.

Upon energization, the UT262A automatically powers on and begins monitoring the three phases. Four LEDs illuminate in sequence clockwise for positive phase rotation or counter‑clockwise for negative while an internal buzzer provides audible confirmation. If any phase is absent, the corresponding LED remains dark, aiding in rapid missing‑phase diagnosis. After three minutes of inactivity, the detector shuts off to conserve its replaceable R6 batteries.

Beyond phase‑sequence checks, the UT262A detects live conductors, assists in tracing circuit breaks, and supports basic voltage verification (70 – 600 V AC, 40 – 70 Hz). Its lightweight (≈180 g) yet durable plastic housing and straightforward LED–buzzer interface make it an indispensable tool for installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of motors, switchgear, and distribution panels.

The UNI-T UT279 Transformer Grounding Current Tester is designed to perform online measurements of grounding and leakage currents in transformer iron cores, enabling technicians to detect potential faults without interrupting service. Housed in a rugged handheld unit, it incorporates a clamp-on sensor that encircles grounding wires or cores, allowing non-contact current sensing. The tester’s internal microprocessor processes signals captured by its high-permeability magnetic core, filtering noise and isolating true leakage currents even in environments with strong electromagnetic interference.

Data are presented on a vibrant color touchscreen, displaying both numerical readings and waveform visuals in real time, facilitating rapid assessment of transformer health. A built-in memory stores measured values and waveforms, which can be transmitted via a USB connection to a computer for further analysis. The device is powered by standard alkaline batteries, ensuring portability and ease of replacement in the field. Its ergonomic design balances weight and form factor to enable single-handed operation, while its durable construction withstands the rigors of industrial environments.

Overall, the UT279 exemplifies a modern approach to transformer maintenance, combining intuitive touch controls, reliable signal processing, and convenient data handling in a single instrument. Its seamless integration of hardware and software effectively streamlines preventive maintenance tasks.

makers-451642.summary: The UNI-T UT225B is a wireless high & low voltage TTR tester offering precise, safe transformer turns ratio measurements for power system diagnostics.

blocks.text: UNI-T UT225B Wireless High & Low Voltage Transformer Turns Ratio Testers

The UNI-T UT225B presents itself as a purpose-built solution for swift, non-intrusive on-site transformer turns-ratio testing, merging rugged construction with user-centric ergonomics. Encased in a robust red-and-grey polypropylene shell, the handheld tester measures just 78 × 165 × 42 mm and weighs approximately 800 g, striking a balance between portable lightness and confidence-inspiring solidity . Its pistol-style grip flows into a flared base, enabling secure one-handed operation even when wearing protective gloves or working within cramped switchgear assemblies.

Dominating the front face is a high-contrast, backlit LCD panel flanked by five responsive membrane buttons. Each key delivers a positive tactile click, allowing technicians to navigate through measurement modes without diverting attention from the display. A slender, fold-out antenna sits discreetly atop the unit, ready to extend for uninterrupted wireless communication from the primary current transformer (CT1) at distances of up to 100 m .

The UT225B’s dual-clamp architecture comprises a high-voltage CT1 with a 48 mm jaw opening for conductors up to 35 kV systems, and a low-voltage CT2 featuring a 32 mm jaw and five interchangeable 1 m leads for precise secondary current capture. Both clamps exhibit matte-textured surfaces and reinforced hinge assemblies, ensuring smooth, repeatable engagement and reliable alignment around live conductors. Color-coded connectors snap positively into the tester’s rear-mounted ports, while a rugged nylon carry bag and an insulated extension stick safeguard components during transport.

Ergonomic contours and a rubberized side-boot enhance grip, dampen impacts, and protect internal circuitry from accidental drops. An intelligently recessed battery compartment secures eight AAA cells, delivering up to 30 hours of continuous operation under typical field conditions. Throughout its form, from balanced weight distribution to reinforced chassis ribs, the UT225B communicates durability and precision readiness, embodying a tool engineered for the rigors of modern power-system diagnostics.

makers-389118.summary: A LM1203 triple-channel 70MHz video amp system for RGB monitors with integrated matched contrast control and individual drive adjustments in a 28-pin DIP package.

blocks.text: LM1203 RGB Video Amplifier System 12V 28mA DIP-28 (Wide)

The LM1203 is an integrated circuit designed as a comprehensive video amplifier system specifically for high-resolution RGB color monitors. It consolidates the critical analog signal processing chain for red, green, and blue channels into a single 28-pin package. This chip was engineered to serve as the central component between the video input signals and the cathode drivers of a CRT, handling the essential tasks of amplification and DC level control to ensure accurate and stable color reproduction on the display.

The system incorporates three wideband video amplifiers that are inherently matched for consistent performance across all three color channels. A key aspect of its design is the inclusion of three accurately matched attenuators that provide master contrast control, ensuring the relative intensity of the colors remains balanced as the overall picture level is adjusted. Furthermore, it contains three gated black level clamp comparators, which are crucial for setting and maintaining the correct brightness by clamping the video signal during the blanking interval, preventing picture drift.

To maximize performance in demanding monitor applications, the LM1203 includes a stable voltage reference for the video inputs and provides individual “Drive” adjustment pins for each amplifier. This allows for fine-tuning the gain of each channel to compensate for variations in the CRT’s cathodes or external components, ensuring precise white balance. Its output stages are designed as low-impedance drivers capable of delivering the signal levels required to drive subsequent stages, making it a robust and flexible solution for professional and high-end consumer display systems.

blocks.text: The 74HC139 is a high-speed CMOS logic IC containing two independent 2-to-4 line decoders/demultiplexers in a single package. Each section accepts two binary select inputs and uses an enable input to select one of four outputs. This makes the IC useful for decoding binary signals, selecting devices, and distributing digital control signals.

Each decoder has active-low outputs, meaning the selected output goes LOW when the decoder is enabled, while the other outputs remain HIGH. The device is suitable for digital systems that require compact logic decoding, including microcontroller interfaces, memory selection, and address decoding. Its 16-pin DIP package supports through-hole mounting and prototyping.

A centre-tapped transformer also known as a two-phase three-wire transformer is normally used for rectifier circuits. When a digital project has to work with AC mains a Transformer is used to step down the voltage (in our case, to 24V or 12V) and then convert it to DC by using a rectifier circuit. In a center-tapped transformer, the peak inverse voltage is twice as in a bridge rectifier hence this transformer is commonly used in full wave rectifier circuits.
How to use Center Tapped Transformer

The operation and theory behind a center-tapped transformer are very similar to a normal secondary transformer. A primary voltage will be induced in the primary coil (I1 and I3) and due to magnetic induction, the voltage will be transferred to the secondary coil. Here in the secondary coil of a centre-tapped transformer, there will be an additional wire (T2) which will be placed exactly at the center of the secondary coil, hence the voltage here will always be zero.

If we combine this zero potential wire (T2) with either T1 or T2, we will get a voltage of 12V AC. If this wire is ignored and voltage across T1 and T2 is considered then we will get a voltage of 24V AC. This feature is very useful for the function of a full wave rectifier.
Let us consider the voltage given by the first half of the secondary coil as Va and the voltage across the second half of the secondary coil as Vb as shown in the diagram below
As we know the voltage across the coil depends on the number of turns on the primary and secondary coil. Using the turns ratio formulae we can calculate the secondary voltage as:
Va = Voltage across the first half of Secondary coil
Vb = Voltage across the second half of Secondary coil
Vp = Voltage across the Primary coil
Na = Number of turn in the first half of Secondary coil
Nb = Number of turn in the second half of Secondary coil
Np = Number of turn in the Primary coil

مضخة هواء ضغط سلبي 12 فولت موديل واي بي 555-60 إيه بي إم

تُعد مضخة الهواء ذات الضغط السلبي 12 فولت موديل واي بي 555-60 إيه بي إم خيارًا عمليًا وفعالًا للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى توليد تفريغ هوائي ثابت أو ضغط سلبي موثوق أو تدفق هواء مستمر. تعتمد هذه المضخة على تصميم غشائي مع محرك قوي من فئة 555، مما يمنحها توازنًا جيدًا بين الحجم والأداء وقوة الشفط، لذلك فهي مناسبة للأنظمة الاحترافية والمشروعات الهندسية المتقدمة على حد سواء.

تُستخدم هذه المضخة في عدد كبير من التطبيقات التي تعتمد على الشفط أو حركة الهواء المنظمة، مثل الأجهزة الطبية المساعدة، ومعدات المعامل، وأنظمة أخذ العينات، ووحدات المناولة بالشفط، وأنظمة التحكم الهوائي الصغيرة، وأعمال الأتمتة والروبوتات. ويساعد التصميم الغشائي على توفير أداء مستقر مع إحكام جيد، مما يجعلها مناسبة للأنظمة التي تحتاج إلى ضغط سلبي منتظم أثناء التشغيل.

تعمل المضخة ضمن نطاق جهد من 6 فولت إلى 12 فولت، وتوفر ضغط هواء يصل إلى 80 كيلوباسكال، مع درجة تفريغ أكبر من سالب 50 كيلوباسكال، ومعدل تدفق هواء بدون حمل أكبر من 17 لترًا في الدقيقة. هذه المواصفات تجعلها مناسبة لمجموعة واسعة من الاستخدامات في الشفط ونقل الهواء والقياس والمعالجة الهوائية. كما أن حجمها المدمج يسهل دمجها داخل الأجهزة صغيرة المساحة أو الأنظمة المحمولة أو المشروعات المخصصة.

وتتميز المضخة بسهولة التوصيل مع الخراطيم بفضل أقطار مدخل ومخرج الهواء المناسبة، إلى جانب بنية ميكانيكية جيدة تساعد على الاستخدام المتكرر داخل أنظمة المختبرات والتحكم الصناعي والتطبيقات البيئية ومشروعات النماذج الأولية. سواء كنت تعمل على تطوير نظام شفط مخصص، أو ترغب في بناء مشروع يعتمد على التفريغ الهوائي، أو تحتاج إلى مضخة مدمجة لنظام هندسي صغير، فإن هذا الموديل يقدم أداءً عمليًا في حجم مناسب.

blocks.text: Sliding Thread Screw Removal Drill Bit Set 2pcs

Sliding Thread Screw Removal Drill Bit Set 2pcs is a compact precision repair bit set designed for removing stripped, slipped, damaged, rusty, or broken small screws from mobile phones, tablets, electronic housings, precision devices, and repair workpieces. The set includes two different functional bits: one drill-style bit for creating or cleaning a starting hole in the damaged screw head, and one threaded extractor-style bit for locking into the damaged screw and helping remove it with controlled rotation.

This Sliding Thread Screw Removal Drill Bit Set is made for technicians who frequently face stripped screws during mobile phone repair, motherboard service, frame disassembly, tablet repair, laptop maintenance, and other delicate electronic repair tasks. When a screw head becomes rounded, worn, rusted, or damaged, normal screwdrivers may slip and make the problem worse. This set provides a practical two-step solution for controlled screw removal.

The first bit is used to drill, open, or prepare the stripped screw head. The second bit is used to grip the prepared damaged screw and help pull it out with less slipping. This makes the set useful when standard precision screwdrivers can no longer lock into the screw slot. It is especially helpful for small screws used around phone charging ports, speaker areas, bottom covers, internal brackets, back covers, and electronic assemblies.

The bits use a 2.35mm shank, making them compatible with many electric grinding pens, electric sharpening pens, micro rotary tools, and suitable precision handles that accept 2.35mm accessories. This compatibility makes the set a useful accessory for technicians who already use compact electric sanding pens or repair rotary tools in their workstation.

The provided product images show the set being used on a damaged screw area near a phone charging port, demonstrating its intended purpose for precision electronics repair. The images also indicate the two bit lengths: approximately 49.7mm for the drill-style bit and approximately 44.5mm for the screw removal bit. Both bits have a 2.35mm handle diameter.

Made from extra-hard alloy material with high-speed steel and tungsten steel characteristics, the bits are designed for durability, wear resistance, and deformation resistance during careful use. Their slim form helps reach tight repair positions where larger screw extractors cannot be used.

طقم بنط إزالة المسامير المفوتة قطعتين

طقم بنط إزالة المسامير المفوتة قطعتين هو طقم صغير مخصص لفنيين صيانة الهواتف والأجهزة الإلكترونية، يساعد في التعامل مع المسامير التي تلف رأسها أو أصبحت لا تمسك مع المفك العادي. الطقم مناسب لإزالة المسامير المفوتة أو المتآكلة أو المكسورة أو الصدئة في الهواتف، التابلت، الأجهزة الدقيقة، وأعمال الصيانة التي تحتاج إلى تحكم عالي ومساحة عمل صغيرة.

في صيانة الهواتف، من أكثر المشاكل المزعجة وجود مسمار صغير رأسه تالف أو مفوت، خصوصًا في مناطق مثل أسفل الهاتف، بجوار منفذ الشحن، حول السماعات، أو داخل شاسيه الجهاز. عند استخدام مفك غير مناسب أو عند تكرار الفك والتركيب، قد يتلف رأس المسمار ويصبح من الصعب إخراجه بالمفكات التقليدية. هذا الطقم يوفر حلًا عمليًا مكونًا من قطعتين للمساعدة في إخراج هذا النوع من المسامير.

القطعة الأولى عبارة عن بنطة رفيعة تستخدم لفتح أو تجهيز نقطة في رأس المسمار التالف. بعد ذلك يتم استخدام القطعة الثانية ذات الشكل المخصص للإمساك بالمسمار التالف والمساعدة على إخراجه مع الدوران الهادئ. هذه الطريقة تساعد على تقليل الانزلاق مقارنة بمحاولة استخدام مفك عادي على رأس مسمار تالف.

يأتي الطقم بمقاس ساق ٢٫٣٥ مم، وهو مقاس شائع في كثير من أقلام الجلخ الكهربائية الصغيرة، وأقلام الصنفرة الدقيقة، وبعض مقابض الأدوات الدوارة المستخدمة في صيانة الهواتف. لذلك يمكن اعتباره إضافة مهمة لأي فني يستخدم أدوات صيانة دقيقة داخل الورشة.

الصور المرفقة توضح استخدام الطقم على مسمار تالف بجوار منفذ شحن هاتف، وهذا يوضح طبيعة استخدامه في أعمال صيانة الموبايل الدقيقة. كما توضح الصور أن طول البنطة الأولى حوالي ٤٩٫٧ مم، وطول بنطة الإزالة حوالي ٤٤٫٥ مم، مع قطر ساق ٢٫٣٥ مم لكل قطعة.

Materials: flame-retardant housing with side ventilation and internal heat-sink path.
Best practice: operate on a hard, non-flammable surface with free airflow; avoid covering vents.
Quick everyday charge (Auto): insert cells → MODE to CHARGE → leave AUTO enabled → the charger chooses a safe current and finishes at END.

Revive Ni-MH (Repair): pick REPAIR at 250–500 mA to reduce memory effects and improve performance (effectiveness varies with cell condition).

كماشة جيب متعددة الاستخدامات ٦×١ – أداة ستانلس ستيل مدمجة مع كشاف

كماشة الجيب متعددة الاستخدامات ٦×١ هي أداة عملية صغيرة تجمع أهم الوظائف في تصميم واحد، مناسبة للحمل اليومي والرحلات والإصلاحات السريعة. مصنوعة من ستانلس ستيل متين لتتحمل الاستخدام المتكرر وتكون خيارًا ممتازًا لشنطة الأدوات أو شنطة الطوارئ أو حتى في السيارة.

تعتمد الأداة على كماشة دقيقة مع قاطع سلك مدمج لالتقاط الأشياء الصغيرة، الثني الخفيف، وقص الأسلاك الرفيعة أو أربطة التثبيت. كما تحتوي على أدوات أساسية للاستخدام اليومي مثل سكين ومفك مسطح ومفك صليبة وفتاحة زجاجات—وهي أهم الوظائف التي يعتمد عليها أغلب المستخدمين.

وبحسب التجميعة أو النسخة، قد تأتي الأداة أيضًا بوظائف إضافية ظاهرة في التصميم مثل كشاف إضاءة ومنشار صغير ووظيفة مفتاح ربط لزيادة المرونة أثناء الرحلات والصيانة الخفيفة. التصميم القابل للطي يجعلها سهلة الحمل، مع شكل عملي يساعد على ثبات القبضة أثناء الاستخدام.
